title: Paul Éluard's mantis collection and Caillois' mantis folklore research

tellings.quote: One of his friends, Paul Elard, another of the founding surrealists, had this insane manted collection in his home.

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani, speaking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Paul Éluard, one of the founders of surrealism (an early 20th century art movement), kept an extraordinary collection of praying mantises in his home in France. He links this to a writer, Roger Caillois, who studied the folklore surrounding the mantis. Jorjani tells it to show how strongly this insect gripped the imagination of that circle of thinkers.
